clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years)
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years) 60 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 60 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years)
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 120 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is given for turnover requirements.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is given for experience requirements.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorization and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 364542 /ePBG Detail
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 3,64,542 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers (goods) or service providers qualify for EMD exemption; traders do not.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming EMD exemption must upload valid supporting documents with the bid.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Turnover must be proven with audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted showing supplies in each required financial year.

clauses.heading: 6. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 80% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 80% of bid quantity to government/PSU in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
clauses.quote: the bidders are required to submit EMD of Rs.3,64,542/- in favour of The R egistrar, GGSIP University in the form of Demand Draft / NEFT/RTGS.
clauses.summary: Bidders must submit EMD of Rs 3,64,542 by DD or NEFT/RTGS to the Registrar, GGSIP University.

clauses.quote: A Bid speciﬁc MAF issued by OEM is required only for Core Switc h, Distribution Switch, Access Switch and Network Management Soft ware to be uploaded.
clauses.summary: A bid-specific OEM authorization (MAF) is required for the switches and network management software.

clauses.heading: 26 Generic
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied similar products to government/PSU for 3 years before bid opening.

clauses.heading: 31 Generic
clauses.quote: Manufacturer Authorization: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Distributors bidding must furnish an OEM authorization certificate with OEM contact details.
